title: Classic Caesar Salad
description: A timeless Continental salad made with crisp romaine lettuce, homemade croutons, authentic Caesar dressing, and freshly shaved Parmesan cheese. Perfect as an appetizer or with optional grilled chicken for a main course.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Romaine lettuce – 2 medium heads (fresh, crisp; inner leaves preferred)
Parmesan cheese – 60 g (freshly shaved or grated)
Freshly ground black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For the Croutons (Homemade)
items: French baguette or country bread – 150 g (cut into 1.5 cm cubes)
Garlic – 1 clove, lightly crushed (optional, for aroma)

ingredients.title: For the Caesar Dressing (Authentic Version)
items: Olive oil – 80 ml (extra virgin, cold pressed)
Freshly ground black pepper – to taste

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Croutons
steps: Toss bread cubes with olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Spread on a baking tray and toast at 180°C for 8–10 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Remove garlic after baking. Cool and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Caesar Dressing
steps: In a stainless steel bowl, whisk together egg yolks, garlic, anchovy paste, mustard, lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce until smooth.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking constantly to form a smooth, creamy emulsion.
Add grated Parmesan, adjust salt and pepper, and whisk to finish.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Salad
steps: Tear romaine lettuce into large bite-size pieces. Chill for 10 minutes for extra crispness.
In a chilled mixing bowl, toss lettuce gently with Caesar dressing until lightly coated.
Add half the croutons and Parmesan shavings; toss briefly again.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plating
steps: Plate attractively — tall and layered for height.
Garnish with remaining Parmesan, a few croutons, and a light grind of black pepper.
Optional: Top with grilled chicken breast, poached egg, or anchovy fillets for variations.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately after tossing for maximum crispness.
Top with grilled chicken breast, poached egg, or anchovy fillets for variations.
Serve on chilled plates for a fine-dining presentation.

chefTips: Always use fresh, crisp romaine hearts — soggy leaves ruin the texture.
Anchovies are essential for the authentic Caesar umami flavor; don't skip them.
Use wooden salad bowls when possible to maintain temperature and aesthetic.
Chill your plates for fine-dining presentation.
